name: Maheswari Vedhachalam
credentials: BAMS · Ayurveda Practitioner · Registered Massage Therapist · Certified Spiritual Healer (ASHA) · Certified Herbalist
bio: Maheswari Vedhachalam holds a Bachelor of Ayurveda Medicine and Surgery (BAMS) from Dr. M.G.R. Medical University, Chennai (2012), with a hospital internship at the Government General Hospital, Chennai. She has practised Ayurveda for over 14 years in India, Qatar and Canada, and is also a Registered Massage Therapist, a certified spiritual healer with the Association of Spiritual Healers of Alberta, and a certified herbalist. BAMS is a degree in Ayurvedic medicine; it is not a medical doctor qualification in Canada.
